story: Robert Ellis was a young Houston traditionalist when he played Pickathon in 2012. He had self-released The Great Rearranger in 2009, and New West signed him for Photographs in 2011, a record American Songwriter counted among its top 50 of the year. The Americana Music Association named him an emerging act in 2012. He moved to Nashville and put out The Lights from the Chemical Plant in February 2014, nominated for Album of the Year. Texas Piano Man followed in 2019, and he still tours solo, road-testing songs about fatherhood.
artist_reel_line: He tours solo, road-testing new songs about fatherhood.

story: Lake Street Dive met at the New England Conservatory in Boston, trained as jazz musicians, and were winning crowds one set at a time when they played Pickathon in 2012. They came back in 2013. Bad Self Portraits, recorded in Maine in 2012 and held up by contract issues, came out on Signature Sounds. The Americana Music Association nominated them for Duo/Group of the Year in 2014 and 2016. Side Pony followed on Nonesuch in 2016 and Good Together in 2024, and What About Flamingos? is due in February 2027.
artist_reel_line: What About Flamingos? is due in February 2027, with a title single out.
